BiblicalUsage: Gôʿal means loathing, the casting out of a newborn left in the open field. It stands in Ezekiel 16:5, where Jerusalem is cast out to the lothing of her person.
TheologicalSignificance: This one, gôʻal, I take at face value: loathing, abhorrence.
